dataset_manifest.topology: directed ring; each outgoing hop is a distinct edge; self-loops/multiplicity retained

measurement_semantics.execution_contract: Measure operations on one loaded/open database handle after the configured query warmup. This is a steady-state latency view.

profile_contract.phase_contract: profile outputs classify raw timers into operation families and semantic phases when available.

workload_isolation.cold-ish: fresh loaded adapter/database per measured non-load workload sample
workload_isolation.load_nodes_edges: fresh adapter/database per warmup and measured load sample
workload_isolation.mutating_warm_opened: fresh loaded adapter/database per mutating warmup and measured sample, excluding load/open from measured latency
